tagline: Global leader in personal care and home fragrance, driven by the belief that everybody deserves to feel good
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the most relevant as it measures the commercial efficiency of each selling square foot in store, a key driver in physical retail, especially during periods of macroeconomic pressure. It directly reflects product appeal and customer experience.

kpis.short: Sales per Average Selling Square Foot
kpis.name: Sales per Average Selling Square Foot
kpis.explanation: Amount generated per square foot of in-store selling space.
kpis.description: In 2025, sales per square foot declined by 2%, falling from $1,042 to $1,026, reflecting pressure on customer traffic despite a stable average basket size.
kpis.signal: WOW: key performance indicator in physical retail

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenues after deductions for returns and promotions.
kpis.description: Net sales reached $7,291 million in 2025, down 0.2% compared to 2024, with mixed performance in North America offset by international growth.

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from core operations before taxes and interest.
kpis.description: Operating income declined by 11% in 2025 to $1,126 million, driven by higher overhead expenses and lower gross margin.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by net sales.
kpis.description: Operating margin decreased from 17.3% in 2024 to 15.4% in 2025, impacted by higher costs and inflation in expenses.

kpis.name: Total Selling Square Feet
kpis.explanation: Total area dedicated to retail selling space across the company's stores.
kpis.description: Total selling square footage increased by 2%, reaching 5,493 thousand square feet, reflecting an international expansion and store modernization strategy.

kpis.name: Cost Savings Plan
kpis.explanation: Targeted cost savings amount over two years under the Consumer First Formula transformation initiative.
kpis.description: The company targets $250 million in savings by 2026, with $175 million expected in 2026, to reinvest in product innovation and brand building.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating income adjusted for exceptional charges related to transformation and management transition.
kpis.description: Adjusted operating income was $1,156 million in 2025, after adding back transformation and management transition costs totaling $30 million.
kpis.signal: Underlying performance stronger than reported figures

kpis.name: International Net Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth in net sales outside North America, primarily driven by expansion into new markets and online sales.
kpis.description: International net sales reached $314 million in 2025, up 4.9% compared to 2024, supported by expansion into new markets and online sales.
kpis.signal: International growth as a strategic lever

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, including attacks on its information systems and sensitive data. A dedicated CISO and governance committees are in place.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive personal care and home fragrance market, which may affect its sales and revenues.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to regulations and laws that may change and impact its operations.

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to geopolitical risks, including political and economic changes in countries where it operates, affecting its international business.

ai_positioning.summary: BBWI mentions artificial intelligence in its risk governance. The company has established Data Governance and Artificial Intelligence committees co-chaired by the CISO, CIO, and Chief Privacy Officer to oversee responsible technology and data management. AI-related risks are integrated into the enterprise risk management program.
evidence: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) leads information security program with master's degree in information assurance and over 25 years of cybersecurity experience
Data Governance and Artificial Intelligence committees co-chaired by CISO, CIO, and Chief Privacy Officer
Committees oversee programs addressing data management, security, privacy and AI through unified frameworks
ERM team oversees identification and mitigation of enterprise risks including AI risks
